why: Done but odd: the toy car's wheel step ("Put both wheels on a layer WHEELS"). The learner drew one wheel, made it a block WHEEL (its circle on layer 0, the usual practice so it takes the insert's layer) and inserted it twice on layer WHEELS at (25, 0) and (95, 0). In AutoCAD both wheels are on WHEELS, show in its colour and freeze with it; the DXF just has no CIRCLE whose own layer is WHEELS.

step.title: Put the wheels on their own layer
step.instructions: Make a layer named WHEELS, select both wheel circles and move them onto it (Properties > Layer). Save as toy_car.dxf.
